scope: CVG-004 bounded manual advance-payment issuance and append-only compensation

criteria.description: The canonical 0148 immutable source, tenant transaction context, idempotency UoW, audit/outbox primitives and finance authorization boundary exist for the bounded commands.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests can be written for exact cents, transaction context, idempotency, audit/outbox atomicity, RLS/concurrency and the finance page before implementation.
criteria.limitations: A bounded result requires implementation, fresh PostgreSQL evidence, SPA/API regression, security review and control-plane reconciliation.

gaps: The write repository, API routes, UI integration, tests and post-implementation review are not complete at gate creation.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded manual advance-payment issuance and append-only compensation
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and local/disposable PostgreSQL, API and SPA verification using the existing 0148 ledger. Require billing.manage, exact BRL cents, tenant UoW/idempotency, transaction-scoped audit/outbox and RLS. Exclude cash/journal/receivable links, refund/cancellation, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding refund/cancellation/reversal, cash/bank/PIX/receivable/journal integration, backfill, provider, target operation, production/deployment action or release acceptance.

next_action: Write focused RED tests for the repository, API route and finance page, then implement the bounded write path without changing migration 0148.
